selector-disallowed-list.message: Phase 6a F28 layer-2: jobs-pane.css must not carry global selectors. Scope all rules under .jobs-bucket / .job-card / #jobs-pane / #jobs-buckets-container / .jobs-pane-* to prevent cross-pane CSS leak that would drift the Phase 5 visual baseline.

Phase 6b F28 layer-2: action-required.css must not carry global selectors. Scope all rules under .action-required-widget / #action-required-section to prevent cross-pane CSS leak that would drift the multiplexer visual baseline.
Phase 6b F28 layer-2: tts-chrome.css must not carry global selectors. Scope all rules under .tts-chrome / #tts-pane to prevent cross-pane CSS leak that would drift the multiplexer visual baseline.

Phase 6c F28 layer-2: conversation-mode-pin.css must not carry global selectors. Scope all rules under .sender-card[data-pinned-conv-mode] / .sender-card[data-focus-flash] attribute selectors to prevent cross-pane CSS leak that would drift the multiplexer visual baseline. Note: AC-B15 hard-gate ALSO enforces zero keyframe definitions for focus-flash in this file — Node B CSS is the single source of truth for that keyframe.

Phase 6c Node B F28 layer-2: focus-tray.css must not carry global selectors. Scope all rules under #focus-mode-toggle / #focus-tray / .focus-tray-* / .sender-card[data-focus-hidden] selectors. Owns the focus-flash @keyframes definition as SSOT per AC-B15.
Phase 6c Node A F28 layer-2: persona-modal.css must not carry global selectors. Scope all rules under .persona-popover / .persona-popover-* selectors.
Phase 6c Node C F28 layer-2: sender-card-recorder.css must not carry global selectors. Scope all rules under .cc-voice-input / .cc-voice-input-* selectors.
